neighbours.label: The British spelling token ' enrol' (enrol, enrolment); American ' enroll' and synonyms stay quiet
fire: Families may enrol their sons at the new academy in June.
Students who enrol early pay a lower fee.
Thousands of nurses rushed to enrol in the programme.
It is easy to enrol online using the college portal.
The clinic will enrol forty patients in the trial.
We had to enrol him twice because of a lost form.
Schools saw a sharp rise in enrolment after the reform.
Adults can now enrol in evening classes for free.
quiet: Families may register their sons at the new academy in June.
Students who apply early pay a lower fee.
Thousands of nurses rushed to enroll in the programme.
It is easy to sign up online using the college portal.
The clinic will recruit forty patients in the trial.
We had to register him twice because of a lost form.
Schools saw a sharp rise in attendance after the reform.
Adults can now enroll in evening classes for free.

notes: Card: ' enrol' x5, ' hooked' x3, Japanese 申し込み x2, on a gate-closed pole. Probe: ' enrol' 0.72-0.84, ' enroll' 0.11, register 0.02, sentence-initial Enrolment 0.03, ' hooked' 0.33-0.35. So the label is the spelling, not the meaning, and ' hooked' is outside it.
